title: ODA/peer spec currency and end-to-end failure chain
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan update
scope: Reconcile public ODA DWG specification currency against the new peer-maintained LibreDWG specification-diff reference
Crosswalk ODA v5.4.1 AcDs DataStorage container semantics with current peer-reported payload-loss behavior
Recheck entity/carrier distinctions and downstream consumer limits across Autodesk, ezdxf, ACadSharp, LibreDWG, and FreeCAD sources
Refine the existing plan's implementation-ready evidence chain without adding findings or validation cadence

sources.project: Open Design Alliance DWG specification v5.4.1
sources.observation: ODA v5.4.1 remains the public normative source reviewed here. Sections 20.4.41 and 24 distinguish modeler object shells, the AcDs byte-stream container, segment/data indexes, handle-bearing data records, optional blob pages, and SAB payload markers. The document explicitly excludes detailed ACIS/SAB semantics; its AcDs section names REGION and 3DSOLID for SAB records.

sources.project: LibreDWG README, NEWS, and ODA spec diff
sources.observation: LibreDWG describes a peer-maintained fixed ODA-5.4.2 diff against the project's ODA-5.4.1 specification. This indicates a source-currency check opportunity, but the peer diff is not itself a newly published ODA specification and was not treated as normative.

The report pins a generated AC1032 DXF REGION SAB loss to LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764 and describes DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF conversion where the REGION shell survives while carrier bytes/ACDSDATA do not. The recipe is scratch-generatable; its 5,489-byte count is an observation, not a format constant. No attachment or peer output was downloaded or run.

sources.project: Autodesk 3DSOLID DXF reference and ezdxf ACIS browser documentation
sources.observation: Autodesk's entity reference documents generic 3DSOLID groups 1/3, modeler version 70, and history owner 350. ezdxf documents raw SAT/SAB browsing/export and its version split. These clarify carrier syntax and inspection roles but do not define DWG AcDs or general ACIS geometry semantics.

The sources report separate writer omission of modeler entities, an open writer proposal, unresolved AC1032 whole-file AutoCAD rejection despite an entity-byte comparison, and process-fatal recursive DXF parser paths. These are peer failure shapes only; they are not local reproductions or proof of current released behavior.

The guide describes distinct C++ and legacy Python importer profiles, DWG-to-DXF conversion followed by the configured importer, and no stock embedded ACIS/SAT import. GitHub indicates that the documentation repository was archived in April 2026, so it is treated as profile documentation rather than current runtime qualification.

existingSubplansRefined: S0/PAR-07: ODA v5.4.1 remains normative; peer-maintained spec diffs are secondary review aids
PAR-07/S8: distinguish AcDs container/index/record/blob/entity closure from opaque carrier and semantic geometry evidence
PAR-06/PAR-14/PAR-49: separate parser progress, complete output structure, per-source dispositions, and consumer acceptance
assessment.planImpact: Add a spec-currency check for LibreDWG's peer-maintained ODA 5.4.2 diff while preserving ODA v5.4.1 as normative. Refine AcDs readiness around segment/data indexes, handle-bearing records, large blob-page closure, entity association, and independent output/consumer checks. Keep peer-only failures advisory and reuse existing local owners.

method.limitations: The LibreDWG 5.4.2 diff was identified in project documentation but not adopted as normative. GitHub issue statements are peer reports; no peer source was built, no attachment was fetched, and no local defect was established. FreeCAD documentation is archived and does not qualify an installed runtime.
